tools.name: check
tools.description: Checks the merge-lang program at path. The text is the langc check --json report document.

tools.name: fmt
tools.description: Gives the canonical text of the merge-lang program at path, as langc fmt.

tools.name: sim
tools.description: Runs the bounded schedule search of the merge-lang program at path, as langc sim.

tools.name: explain-code
tools.description: Gives the row of the diagnostic code in docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md, as langc explain-code.

fix: allocate stock by escrow (A ↦ 1, B ↦ 0)
